title: kbmon --events exports the same query-log delivery again after any later distill.log line
goal: a delivery's id and time stay the same while its apply outcome stands last in distill.log, so --since the returned cursor never exports it again

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();q=os.path.join(H,'querylog');os.makedirs(q);L=os.path.join(q,'distill.log')
open(L,'w').write('apply --push: pushed ok\n')
E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd(),KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(H,'c.sqlite'))
k=lambda *a: json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--events',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=120).stdout)
c=k().get('cursor');time.sleep(1.2);open(L,'a').write('x\n')
d=k('--since',str(c))
again=[x.get('name') for x in d.get('events',[])+d.get('spans',[]) if str(x.get('name','')).startswith('kb.delivery')]
if again: print('the same delivery exported again: %r'%again);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: an unrelated log line exports no delivery again')

notes: SP-qvlnptiw review (ST-jx3c5vxm g1 changed): the delivery time is the log's last write and its id delivery-<when>, so any appended line makes a new record.
